provenance.baselineCompilerRelocation: Only two static import specifiers use absolute file URLs; both dependency sources equal the original Git versions.

method.timing: Serial uninstrumented capturePhysical (1024-frame blocks) or run(N) calls only. Fresh reset instance for every run. WASM compilation, construction, input submission, copying, snapshots, assertions and hashing are outside timers.
method.order: One discarded run per case/variant, then rotate the three variants and reverse on odd trials. Warmup is min(4096,frames) or min(100000,instructions). No forced GC, affinity or V8 flags.
method.attribution: baseline=original native+original compiler; native-only=current native+original compiler; candidate=current native+current compiler. All modules are generated and compiled before warmup, then bound as precompiled modules to fresh native memory outside execution timers.
method.coldTranslation: Generation and WASM compilation times are single startup observations per case/variant, outside execution timers. They are retained as diagnostics, not stable cold-start performance estimates.
method.parity: Every pair and all later baseline runs match full state/_state diagnostics/registers/IO/SRAM/Flash/EEPROM/IRQ frames at each block, raw Float32 PCM bytes, and remaining pin events. Kernel count/register/cycle and constant-low PCM assertions are additional checks.
method.scope: Firmware: 250ms by default, compatible clock and fixed-ps resumable CPU. Kernel: direct throughput, internal20MHz and finite 20MHz CLKI /1,/256 at25ms; every source edge still serviced.
method.limits: Node host timing with CPU, peripherals, native pin/audio integration and JS batch copying coupled. No DSP filtering or browser latency guarantee. Scheduling, tiering and GC may affect samples.
